findings.summary: R1 requirement trace to M1/M2 milestones is incomplete: M1 deliverables do not explicitly include input rejection logic for chat logs or non-canonical artifacts

evidence.note: R1 requires rejection of chat logs and non-canonical inputs as authoritative sources
M1 deliverables list does not explicitly mention chat log rejection or non-canonical input blocking logic
AT1 exit criterion mentions rejection but M1 deliverables do not trace to the rejection mechanism

findings.summary: R2 requirement declares repo_context.json schema must be 'defined and required' but M1 deliverables do not explicitly include schema definition as a deliverable artifact

evidence.note: R2 requires typed, versioned repo_context.json schema to be defined
M1 deliverables mention validation but do not list repo_context.json schema definition as a deliverable

findings.summary: R3 requirement declares workspace_context.json schema must be 'defined and required' but M1 deliverables do not explicitly include schema definition as a deliverable artifact

evidence.note: R3 requires typed, versioned workspace_context.json schema to be defined
M1 deliverables mention validation but do not list workspace_context.json schema definition as a deliverable

findings.summary: AT1 acceptance test maps to both M1 and M2 milestones but the test procedure does not indicate which aspects are validated in M1 vs M2

evidence.note: AT1 procedure does not distinguish M1 vs M2 validation scope
AT1 maps to both M1 and M2
